name: Do I need a plumber to remove my shower?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a plumber to remove my shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a shower requires shutting off the water supply to the bathroom or the whole home and capping open supply pipes. If you are keeping your existing layout, rough plumbing lines stay in place while fixtures are removed. However, if you plan to upgrade to a barrier-free base, add body sprays, or adjust the drain location, plumbing lines must be rerouted by a professional. As a general contractor, Abraham Becerra coordinates certified trade partners for plumbing modifications while his hands-on team oversees framing and wall prep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, shutting off, capping, or relocating water lines and drain assemblies requires professional plumbing expertise, coordinated alongside demolition and framing.
